title: Export declared secrets into host pre_start commands
description:
Ngramx treats secrets in `.env` as present, then runs host `setup.pre_start` commands without exporting those values. Unset `$NOVA_ACCOUNT_EMAIL` / `$NOVA_LICENSE_KEY` vanish, so `composer config http-basic.nova.laravel.com $NOVA_*` becomes a GET of a missing setting and `ngramx worktree` exits 1. Worktrees also do not inherit the parent `auth.json`.

Export declared secrets into the host command environment (shell first, then `.env`). Copy parent `auth.json` into the worktree before `up`, and restore it afterwards so a `composer config` SET cannot replace a working Composer login with a different `.env` account.

## Goal

Worktree environments must start reliably for every Laravel Nova project. Developers should not have to copy `auth.json` by hand or export secrets before `nwt`.
